content.title: Appliance Energy Transfer | Source Loss, Carrier Storage and Recipient Gain
content.summary: An air extractor transfers stage glow between two adult mascots. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: Two clearly adult original figures remain distinct. + One visible carrier preserves energy continuity. + Loss at the source matches gain in the machine. + A neutral pause proves the intermediate state. + The final recipient gains the effect while the source stays depleted.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place two clearly adult original stage mascots in one rehearsal room; performer A glows while performer B holds an unbranded air extractor. A's glow dims in three steps while the extractor chamber fills to one marked line. Release the silver mist around performer B until B glows; A stays ordinary and watches the result.
required_anchors: Two clearly adult original figures remain distinct.
One visible carrier preserves energy continuity.
A neutral pause proves the intermediate state.
The final recipient gains the effect while the source stays depleted.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An air extractor transfers stage glow between two adult mascots. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 同一室内先让角色甲拥有清楚光环，角色乙启动家电后，雾状能量沿可见吸入路径离开甲并进入机器；片刻常态确认后，能量再转移到乙，形成守恒式荒诞接力。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: Two clearly adult original figures remain distinct.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "Two clearly adult original figures remain distinct."

invariants.rule: One visible carrier preserves energy continuity.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "One visible carrier preserves energy continuity."

invariants.rule: Loss at the source matches gain in the machine.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Loss at the source matches gain in the machine."

invariants.rule: A neutral pause proves the intermediate state.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "A neutral pause proves the intermediate state."

invariants.rule: The final recipient gains the effect while the source stays depleted.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final recipient gains the effect while the source stays depleted."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
